overview: RLVMR integrates dense, verifiable meta-reasoning rewards (planning, exploration, reflection, monitoring) into end-to-end reinforcement learning for long-horizon LLM agents, addressing the inefficient exploration problem by combining process-level and outcome-level rewards via the GRPO-MR policy optimization algorithm.

modules.name: Environment Wrapper & MDP Formulation
modules.description: Wraps ALFWorld and ScienceWorld environments into a unified MDP interface, defining state/observation spaces, action spaces (as natural language), and sparse outcome reward signals. Supports task difficulty splits (L0/L1/L2) for evaluating generalization.

modules.name: Meta-Reasoning Tag System
modules.description: Implements the four XML-style meta-reasoning tags (<planning>, <explore>, <reflection>, <monitor>) and the <action> tag, along with parsing logic to extract reasoning types and action content from agent outputs. Enforces the one-tag-per-step format constraint.

modules.name: Trajectory Annotation for Cold-Start
modules.description: Uses a teacher model to annotate raw observation-action trajectories with meta-reasoning tags, inferring the most likely cognitive step preceding each action. Generates synthetic reasoning-rich expert demonstrations for the SFT cold-start phase.

modules.name: Cold-Start Supervised Fine-Tuning
modules.description: Fine-tunes the base LLM on annotated trajectories to learn the meta-reasoning tag syntax and basic reasoning-action generation patterns. Uses a small dataset (e.g., 200 trajectories) with standard cross-entropy loss over multiple epochs.

modules.name: Multi-Trajectory Rollout Engine
modules.description: Performs online multi-turn interaction between the policy model and environments. For each initial state, samples multiple trajectories (rollouts) with the current policy, recording observations, meta-reasoning tags, actions, and per-step state transitions.

modules.name: Meta-Reasoning Reward Computation
modules.description: Computes dense, rule-based process rewards: planning reward (conditional on trajectory success), exploration reward (for novel state-action transitions), reflection reward (when reflection leads to corrective action after failure), and format reward (penalty for invalid tag structure). Implements novelty detection and error-correction verification logic.

modules.name: Outcome Reward & Composite Reward Aggregation
modules.description: Computes the sparse binary outcome reward based on final task success, then aggregates it with step-level meta-reasoning rewards and format penalties to produce the composite per-step reward signal used for policy gradient estimation.

modules.name: Group Relative Advantage Computation (GRPO-MR)
modules.description: Computes two advantage signals: (1) trajectory-level relative advantage by normalizing outcome rewards across rollouts from the same environment, and (2) meta-reasoning-level relative advantage by normalizing meta-reasoning rewards within groups sharing the same tag type and environment. Combines them via a weighted sum controlled by hyperparameter alpha.

modules.name: Policy Optimization (Clipped Surrogate with KL)
modules.description: Implements the GRPO-MR policy gradient update using a clipped surrogate objective with the computed composite advantages. Includes importance sampling ratio computation, PPO-style clipping, and KL divergence regularization against a reference policy to prevent excessive policy drift.

modules.name: Training Loop Controller
modules.description: Manages the overall training workflow: alternating between rollout collection, reward computation, advantage estimation, and policy updates. Handles epoch management, gradient accumulation, and checkpointing. Tracks training stability and convergence.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Computes all evaluation metrics: Success Rate (%), Invalid Action Rate (%), Repetitive Action Rate (%), and cumulative reward (score) for ScienceWorld. Implements detection of repetitive actions (same action yielding same state) and invalid actions (non-executable in current state).

modules.name: Baseline Integration Framework
modules.description: Provides unified interfaces for running comparison baselines: SFT (supervised fine-tuning only), GRPO (outcome-only RL), ETO (offline RL with step-level feedback), GLIDER (hierarchical offline RL), and GiGPO (two-level group policy optimization). Ensures consistent evaluation across methods.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Supports systematic ablation experiments: (1) component ablation removing trajectory-level outcome advantage, meta-reasoning advantage, or cold-start; (2) meta-reasoning tag type ablation removing individual tags (planning, explore, reflection, monitor) and their corresponding rewards.

modules.name: Sensitivity & Hyperparameter Analysis
modules.description: Runs controlled experiments varying the advantage coefficient alpha (balancing outcome vs. meta-reasoning advantages) and the discount factor gamma. Computes training curves (success rate, episode length) for each configuration to assess robustness.

modules.name: Configuration Management & Experiment Tracking
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations (model size, hyperparameters, environment settings) via structured config files. Integrates logging for training metrics, evaluation results, and rollout statistics. Supports experiment reproducibility and result persistence.

modules.name: Visualization & Report Generation
modules.description: Generates training curves (success rate vs. step, episode length vs. step), bar charts comparing metrics across splits (L0/L1/L2) and methods, and LaTeX tables for main results and ablation studies. Produces qualitative trajectory visualizations comparing RLVMR vs. GRPO behaviors.
